question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.**

__A fair-weather friend__ can never be trusted in the times of exigency.
solution:
The correct answer is **'A selfish friend****'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
